producer_boundary: supported exact shared boundary contract version
supported exact producer schema and compiler version
run_integrity_status=PASS for a healthy producer run
typed evidence_status distinct from run integrity
typed downstream_permission_status distinct from evidence presence

producer-declared serialized artifact_file_sha256 for every consumed canonical artifact

typed_evidence_rules.PRESENT: Run integrity PASS with downstream ALLOW when promotable evidence is present.
typed_evidence_rules.NOT_APPLICABLE: Run integrity may PASS with zero atoms and downstream NOT_APPLICABLE.
typed_evidence_rules.APPLICABLE_UNRESOLVED: Run integrity may PASS with repair debt while downstream evidence-dependent permission is DENY.

v551.section85_acceptance: Preserved resolved W01 contract: verify producer version, scope, canonical declarations/hashes and typed state; never require relation_evidence_atoms row_count > 0 for integrity.

state_meaning.PRESENT/ALLOW: certified joint evidence is usable by the evidence-dependent downstream operation
state_meaning.PRESENT/DENY: valid review-only evidence remains present but is not authorized for downstream evidence use
state_meaning.VALID_EMPTY/NOT_APPLICABLE: healthy producer run with no joint evidence to pass downstream
state_meaning.NOT_APPLICABLE/NOT_APPLICABLE: healthy producer run for a non-applicable joint-evidence branch
state_meaning.APPLICABLE_UNRESOLVED/DENY: healthy run reports unresolved applicable evidence without downstream authorization

v551j.section85_acceptance: Require exact v2.2.3 producer manifest, compiler version, typed state, exact scope identity, all manifest-declared canonical Parquet hash/row contracts, and core packet surfaces whenever evidence_status=PRESENT.

v552.v552j_upstream_role: V552J manifest must bind the exact V552 producer manifest path and serialized SHA-256 with coherent scope identity.

v552j.observed_zero_rule: OBSERVED_ZERO is an observed measurement state carried by v552j_structural_join_index; it is never interchangeable with VALID_EMPTY, NOT_APPLICABLE, or APPLICABLE_UNRESOLVED.
v552j.upstream_binding: Rehash and verify the exact V551J v2.2.3 and V552 v3.0 manifests declared by the V552J producer, with coherent run/source/wave/country-or-shard identity.
v552j.section85_acceptance: Require exact V552J manifest version/state/scope, canonical Parquet declarations with serialized hashes, exact upstream manifest hashes, and explicit ALLOW before any evidence-dependent Section85 operation proceeds.
